summary: Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did Hurricane Maria make landfall in Puerto Rico?”: 2017-09-20 (15 sources), 2017-09-22 (2 sources). A primary source says 2017-09-20.

text: Sources agree that Governor Ricardo Rosselló announced the revised official death toll based on the GWU study on 2018-08-28, that the GWU study was publicly released that same day, that the Harvard Chan School study estimated 4,645 deaths, and that the Puerto Rico government updated its official toll to 64 on 2017-12-09. Sources disagree on the date Hurricane Maria made landfall in Puerto Rico, with most reporting 2017-09-20 and a few reporting 2017-09-22. A primary source gives 2017-09-20 where others say 2017-09-22.
